summary: Washington DNR live-in lookout in Pierce County, built 1961 and removed in 1969; footings and a weather station remain. Sources disagree on height and build year.

facts.status_note: Tower removed in 1969; the summit has lookout footings and a weather station.

visit.trail_note: Gravel Forest Service road FS 7710 from Wilkeson; park below the gate.

events.note: Built 1961 by the state's own crew, replacing the nearby South Prairie lookout. The Forest Lookouts page gives 1960 for erection.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Former Fire Lookout Sites register gives N 47.044570 W 121.940140, which matches the record's FFLOS point. The West US Lookouts point in the record is not checked here.

notes_for_editor: Build year conflicts: 1961 (Firelookout, register, Willhite) vs 1960 erection (Forest Lookouts). Height conflicts: 40 ft (register, Firelookout) vs 80 ft (Willhite), so no height_m is recorded. The record's FFLOS coordinates match the register. The West US Lookouts point (47.02399, -121.88122) is about 5 km away and was not checked. The Willhite photo captions are undated apart from the 2015 summit remark. No fires or smokes appear in these four pages. Public access is not stated in any source read, so access is omitted. WebSearch budget was exhausted, so DNR records and newspapers were not searched.
